author: Cleo Abram
description:
Looked out a plane window and wondered…what if I could just bounce on a fluffy cloud? 

Turns out the cloud would need to be MUCH denser…our atmosphere couldn’t hold it up! 

But a place like deep inside JUPITER could!

To see what that’s like and to understand why Jupiter’s MOONS are insane, subscribe!

#moon #cloud #jupiter #sky #earth
title: What If I Could Stand on a Cloud?
